meta.title: How Miami Keeps Creating Value
meta.subtitle: A DelQuant roster construction study, 1995-present
meta.method_note: DelQuant maps player seasons into functional archetypes, studies 31 seasons of roster construction, and summarizes position-relative competitive trait outputs. This demo exposes curated outputs only; model internals, formulas, and scoring weights are intentionally withheld.

framework.archetypes: 54 functional player archetypes derived from historical production shape.
framework.championship_dna: A 31-season study of which archetype combinations and player types translate into playoff outcomes.

competitive_traits.motor: Heart proxy: availability, rebounding, and defensive activity signals.
competitive_traits.decision: Brains proxy: creation, efficiency, and mistake-control signals.
competitive_traits.pressure: Balls proxy: scoring responsibility and shot-pressure signals.

value_lens.value_acquisition: Known production acquired at a market or premium cost.
value_lens.value_creation: Surplus value created through role fit, development, or context unlock.
value_lens.internal_development: Drafted or developed player whose role value compounds inside the system.
value_lens.role_fit: Useful contributor whose value depends on fit inside the roster architecture.

hof_positional_baselines.title: Hall of Fame Positional Baselines
hof_positional_baselines.source_note: Curated modern NBA Hall of Fame cohort with DelQuant-era seasons, including inducted classes through 2025. This is a benchmark layer, not a Hall of Fame prediction model.
hof_positional_baselines.baseline_method: For each Hall of Fame player, DelQuant selects the strongest available DelQuant-era season by HBB composite, then computes positional averages and standard deviations for Motor, Decision, Pressure, and Composite.
